facts.text: I have been thinking about planning a family tree project to preserve family history and memories.
I have been thinking about my own mortality a lot lately.
I want to leave a lasting legacy with the family tree project.
I have heard about Ancestry.com and MyHeritage.
I want to store and organize family recipes online, including my grandma's chicken soup recipe.
I think I will start with MyHeritage because it has a specific feature for family recipes.
I want to import my family tree from Ancestry.com into MyHeritage.
I want to add more information to my family tree in MyHeritage.
I want to add my grandma's chicken soup recipe to MyHeritage.
I want to add stories and photos to the recipe in MyHeritage.
I want to add a picture of my grandma making the soup to the recipe.
I want to add a story about how my grandma used to make the soup for our family gatherings.
I want to add tags or keywords to the recipe so I can find it later.
I want to use the tag or keyword "Grandma's Recipes" for the recipe.
I want to use the tag or keyword "Family Traditions" for the recipe.
I want to organize my family recipes on MyHeritage.
I want to add my siblings or other family members as contributors to my family tree in MyHeritage.
I want my siblings or other family members to add their own recipes and stories.
